title: Topic 13: Travel & Transport - Reading
description: Two short texts with three questions each.
canDoStatement: Name transport, buy tickets, handle simple travel situations

readingBlock.readingText:
TEXT A - Station timetable format
CITY STATION - BUSES TODAY
Olinda ..... ten o'clock ...... seven dollars
Recife ..... ten thirty ....... nine dollars
Santos ..... eleven o'clock ... twelve dollars
Tickets: at the ticket office or in the app.
The ticket office is next to door two.
Good travels!

TEXT B - Chat messages format
Iris: Hi Leo! On Saturday I travel to Salvador!
Leo:  Nice! By plane?
Iris: No, by bus. The plane is very expensive.
Leo:  What time is your bus?
Iris: At seven o'clock in the morning! My brother goes
      with me - he likes Salvador.
Leo:  Two happy travelers! Can you buy a present for
      me there?
